_comment: Documentation Center config. Copy to docs.json and edit per server (gitignored). base_dir may also come from the DOCS_BASE_DIR env var. See DOCS_DESIGN.md / GUIDE.md.
_audience_note: Audience is decided by the top-level SUBFOLDER under base_dir: files under user/ show in the User Guide, files under technical/ in the Technical Guide. Files elsewhere default to technical. An 'overrides' entry (keyed by the path relative to base_dir) always wins and can also set title/description/tags/order. Example layout: base_dir/user/getting-started.md, base_dir/technical/architecture.md.
